decisions: Canonical account identity is authenticated GET wallets/ matching configured immutable wallet, environment and credential revision before GET payments/{id}.
Only canonical GET RECEIVED permits receipt; authenticated webhook only queues an optional worker. CONFIRMED, AUTHORIZED and estimatedCreditDate never post money.
CREDIT_CARD origin metadata and response must match, exact gross equals immutable local invoice; net and fee remain distinct.
No installment/subscription/installmentNumber or installment input fields; anticipated and deleted must be explicit false. Escrow/custody not supported.
creditDate must be a real occurred date, not earlier than paymentDate or invoice date. It is the card receipt book date.
Card-only profile is hashed with canonical safe proof/evidence. PIX/BOLETO149 JSON and receipt evidence stay unchanged. Old card proof without profile requires fresh GET.
No cardholder objects/tokens/PAN/CVV are persisted. No direct card capture, installments, subscriptions, anticipation, escrow settlement or refund/chargeback financial reversal is implemented.

PAYMENT_ANTICIPATED is sticky adverse history for every named origin. A later GET anticipated=false cannot reopen ordinary settlement. Already committed keys/evidence/payments are not rewritten or automatically reversed.
evidence_boundary: Protocol transport is simulated in automated tests. No external bank homologation, live credentials, acquirer or card network settlement was exercised.
